verses.text: A wise son listens to his father's teaching, but a mocker will not listen to correction.
People enjoy good things because of what they say, but unfaithful people are hungry for violence.
Whoever guards their mouth protects their life, but whoever talks too much will be ruined.
Lazy people want things but get nothing, but hard-working people get everything they want.
Good people hate lies, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
Goodness protects people who live honestly, but evil brings sinners down.
Some people pretend to be rich but have nothing. Others pretend to be poor but have great wealth.
A rich person may have to pay a ransom for their life, but a poor person never even hears a threat.
The light of good people shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked goes out.
Pride only leads to arguments, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.
Money gained dishonestly disappears, but whoever earns money little by little makes it grow.
Hope that is put off makes the heart sick, but a wish that comes true is like a tree of life.
Whoever refuses to be taught will pay for it, but whoever respects a command will be rewarded.
The teaching of wise people is a fountain of life. It helps people escape the traps of death.
Good understanding wins favour, but the way of unfaithful people is hard.
Sensible people act with knowledge, but fools show off their foolishness.
A wicked messenger gets into trouble, but a trustworthy messenger brings healing.
Whoever refuses correction will end up poor and ashamed, but whoever accepts correction will be honoured.
A wish that comes true is sweet, but fools hate to turn away from evil.
Walk with wise people and you will become wise, but a friend of fools will get hurt.
Trouble chases sinners, but good things reward good people.
Good people leave an inheritance for their grandchildren, but a sinner's wealth is stored up for good people.
A poor person's field may produce plenty of food, but injustice sweeps it away.
Whoever refuses to discipline their son hates him, but whoever loves him is careful to correct him.
Good people have enough to eat, but the stomachs of the wicked stay hungry.
